notes: kb/Work PB5242 landed. §1985:XIII.3.22.2 prints `VALUE IS literal-1` for "Report Section printable items" (§1985:XIII.3.22.1). The VALUES spelling (2002 13.16.61.1 Format 4) is construct report-value-forms-2002, refused at 85 by VisitValueClause inside a report group description entry; two literals need a repeating entry (COBOL2012), each a 2002 form. Witnesses: 1985-FMT-XIII_3_22_2 and pb5242-report-values-85. Each 2002 form is refused at --std 85 with COBOL0900 by a construct row of the version matrix (tests/version-matrix/constructs/report-*-2002.json, introducedIn 2002), checked on recognition in VersionConformancePass's parse arm, and accepted from COBOL-2002 (ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 115).

next.reason: 1985 Report Writer VALUE clause is only 'VALUE IS literal-1' (§1985:XIII.3.22.2). 2023 report-section Format 4 is '{VALUE IS | VALUES ARE} {literal-1} ...' (§2023:13.18.63.2); 'The words VALUE and VALUES are equivalent' (§2023:13.18.63.3 SR17, applied to the report format by §2023:13.18.63.3 SR34), and more than one operand is allowed in a repeating entry (§2023:13.18.63.3 SR35). Every 1985 form keeps its meaning; 2023 accepts VALUES ARE and several literals, which the 1985 format refuses (looser). 1985 VI.5.15.2's VALUES ARE is the condition-name format only, so no 1985 rule already allows this in a report item.
